dialogues.speaker: Ratimir
dialogues.text: Well? Where do you want to go? I'll get you anywhere, or my name's not Ratimir!

dialogues.speaker: Ratimir
dialogues.text: What sharp eyes you have, my good guest! Let me tell you, I'm renowned throughout the harbor as a tour guide. Why, just saying the name "Ratimir" is liable to get you two thumbs up from the local kids!

dialogues.speaker: Ratimir
dialogues.text: Ask anyone, and they'll tell you that you can't just walk around willy-nilly in Nod-Krai. If you want to get somewhere, and you want to get there safe, you need someone who knows the ground.

dialogues.speaker: Ratimir
dialogues.text: That means a local familiar with the land, who can arrange your itinerary for you. And what do you know, I just happen to be that trustworthy local...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Looking for customers in this freezing cold...?

dialogues.speaker: Ratimir
dialogues.text: Of course! Why wouldn't I... *sigh* Bah, this accursed weather...! If I had some Mora to spare, I'd be huddled up in a bar, my belly full of warm drink...

dialogues.speaker: Ratimir
dialogues.text: Oh, and speaking of bars, I recommend you head down to The Flagship. A drink or two there will make you forget you were ever cold.

dialogues.speaker: Ratimir
dialogues.text: Yeah, sure. But if you change your mind, don't forget to come back, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Ratimir
dialogues.text: Oh, it's a local tavern. They've got unique style and reasonable prices. Pretty natural that anyone would go there, if you ask me.

dialogues.speaker: Ratimir
dialogues.text: If you'd be willing to hire me, I'd be more than willing to take you there for a swig or two right now...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: To forget I was ever cold...

dialogues.speaker: Ratimir
dialogues.text: Exactly, dear guest. "A strong drink is like a dagger of ice down the throat, then a liquid sun in the belly, burning bright enough to fuel dreams." One sip, and I guarantee you'll forget... well, everything.

dialogues.speaker: Ratimir
dialogues.text: What a shame, dear guest, you were so close! Tell you what, how about I arrange your itinerary and walk you through my strategy while I'm at it?

dialogues.speaker: Ratimir
dialogues.text: Impressive, dear guest! Now then, what would you say to a Genius Invokation TCG-themed trip?
